reviews.review_msg: Janice took no responsibility for the decision to run PDP ITEM with only 1 SFU supervisor. We had lots of health and safety concerns during our field school, culminating in hospitalizations and robberies. None of the EDUC 400 activities helped me develop as a TC, whether it was colouring with crayons or painting rocks. A waste of time and money.

Janice said that our PDP cohort would be Burnaby-based, but she changed it on a whim. Transit was tough to get to some of the remote locations. She was overly strict with students who took days off, and she got upset when people missed the performative book clubs where we learned nothing. EDUC 400 is a waste of money. Janice is not a good teacher.

Janice takes offence a lot. She does what is easy for her at the time and has a tendency to get upset at people when things do not go her way. I noticed my course was very disorganized; Janice took it negatively when I asked for more details about the course.

Janice likes to call last-minute meetings and scold teacher candidates. She expects perfection from teacher candidates yet does not follow program guidelines herself. I didn't learn anything of value from EDUC 400 and see it as a waste of time and money. PDP should be 11 months, like UBC.

Janice is directly responsible for the SFU PDP ITEM program no longer running as of 2026. Due to her lack of preparedness, disorganization and inability to run a field school program in a responsible way, students were robbed and hospitalized when the ITEM program last ran. Janice is at fault for not making sure the cohort was better prepared.
